summary: YOURLS is a collection of PHP scripts that enables you to host a private URL redirection service on your own infrastructure. It provides core link shortening capabilities alongside custom aliases, bookmarklets, an API, and analytics tracking.
goodFor: It suits administrators who want complete control over their redirected links and statistics without relying on external third-party services.
watchOut: Because it relies on a mature PHP codebase, you should expect to handle routine security maintenance and configuration tuning yourself.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard web server like Apache or Nginx, a PHP runtime, and a relational database such as MySQL to store your links and metrics.
